proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: Bonus Unarmed Strike grants the ability to make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action — always available while the equipment gate holds, consuming no use-count resource. This is not grant_extra_action (which grants an additional Action) and has no analogue in the current atom inventory.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Bonus Unarmed Strike. You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: substitute_damage_die
proposed_widenings.justification: Martial Arts Die replaces the normal damage die of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons with a class-level-scaled die (d6→d8→d10→d12). This is a die substitution, not an additive modifier — modify_damage_numeric is additive and cannot model 'roll this instead of the weapon's damage die.' The v4 scale_die_size atom exists for progression tracking but there is no delivery atom for substituting a base attack damage die.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Martial Arts Die. You can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons. This die changes as you gain Monk levels, as shown in the Martial Arts column of the Monk Features table.

proposed_widenings.name: substitute_attack_ability
proposed_widenings.justification: Dexterous Attacks grants use of Dex instead of Str for attack and damage rolls of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. The surface has modify_roll_numeric (additive) and modify_roll_advantage, but no ability-substitution atom — nothing that says 'use ability X in place of ability Y for these rolls.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: Dexterous Attacks. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons.

proposed_widenings.name: substitute_maneuver_dc_ability
proposed_widenings.justification: Dexterous Attacks also allows using Dex instead of Str to determine the save DC for Grapple or Shove maneuvers made via Unarmed Strike. This is a DC ability substitution scoped to specific combat maneuvers — no atom covers maneuver-scoped DC ability substitution.
proposed_widenings.evidence: In addition, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC.

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.unarmed_or_monk_weapons
proposed_widenings.justification: The equipment gate requires 'unarmed OR wielding only Monk weapons.' The current wielding_weapon predicate covers named weapon-kind categories (ranged, melee_two_handed, etc.) but has no variant for 'unarmed state' or for 'wielding only weapons of a defined class-specific set.' This disjunction including unarmed state cannot be composed from existing predicates.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

proposed_widenings.name: not_wearing_armor.categories adds 'shield'
proposed_widenings.justification: The equipment gate requires not wielding a Shield. The not_wearing_armor predicate accepts categories 'light | medium | heavy' only; 'shield' is an ArmorTrainingCategory but is absent from the not_wearing_armor category list.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield

notes: All three core mechanics (Bonus Unarmed Strike, Martial Arts Die, Dexterous Attacks) require atoms not in the v4 taxonomy or TS surface. The equipment gate also requires two surface widenings (unarmed-or-Monk-weapons disjunction; shield in not_wearing_armor). Because the atom gaps are fundamental — not secondary riders — the dominant classification is atom_widening. No honest dhall encoding is possible without fabricating atom kinds that would throw in the tracer.
